title: Engineering the sialome of mammalian cells with sialic acid mimetics
protocol: Seed HEK293 cells at 3 × 10^4 cells/cm^2, HeLa cells at 2 × 10^4 cells/cm^2, or Jurkat cells at 3 × 10^5 cells/mL one day before starting the experiment.
Dilute SAMs to a 10× concentration of the desired final concentration in culture medium.
Add SAM to the cells at a 1× final concentration and gently swirl the culture dish to distribute evenly.
Include a volumetric DMSO control sample treated with equal concentrations of DMSO.
Sterilize culture competent glass coverslips by dipping them into 70% ethanol for 30 seconds and wash thoroughly with 1× PBS.
Place one coverslip per well into a 12-well plate and add 0.5 ml poly-L-lysine coating solution.
Incubate the coverslips for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the poly-L-lysine coating solution and thoroughly wash three times with 1× PBS, aspirating all fluid after each wash.
Seed HeLa cells as described in preparation step 10.
Add 100 μM of Ac5Neu5Ac3F or DMSO control to treated cells.
Culture the treated cells for up to 72 hours.
Ensure that the coverslip is at the bottom of the well when adding cells.
Fix the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant and wash the wells twice with 1 mL 1× PBS.
Centrifuge the supernatant at 300 × g for 5 min at 20°C, pellet debris, and store at −20°C.
Add 0.5 mL fixation buffer and incubate for 10 min at RT.
Remove the fixation buffer and discard in hazardous compounds waste.
Wash the wells carefully three times with 1 mL 1× PBS.
Remove the 1× PBS and add 1 mL blocking buffer.
Incubate the wells for 1 h at 20°C or >3 h at 4°C.
Stain the cells with biotinylated MALII.
Wash the coverslip with 1 mL PBS-BSA.
Add 0.5 mL lectin staining solution containing 5 μg/mL biotinylated MALII.
Incubate samples for 1 hour at 20°C or for more than 3 hours at 4°C.
Wash samples three times with 1 mL PBS-BSA.
Wash coverslips twice with PBS-BSA.
Incubate the samples for 30 minutes with 0.5 mL PBS-BSA containing 1 μg/mL streptavidin, Alexa Fluor™ 488 conjugate protected from light at 20°C.
Wash the coverslips twice with 1 mL PBS-BSA and once with 1× PBS.
Incubate samples with 0.5 mL 1 μg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS for 10 minutes at 20°C in the dark.
Wash the coverslips once with 1 mL 1× PBS.
Mount the coverslips with mounting medium onto a microscopy slide and seal the edges of the coverslip with transparent nail polish.
Acquire representative images using the EVOS M5000 imaging system or alternative fluorescence microscopes.
Seed HeLa cells on poly-L-lysine coverslips in 12-wells.
Culture the seeded cells for 2 hours in the presence of 100 μM Ac5SiaNPoc or DMSO control.
Fix the cultured cells as described.
Permeabilize the fixed cells by adding 0.5 mL permeabilization buffer for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the permeabilization buffer and add 1 mL intracellular blocking buffer for 60 minutes at 20°C.
Wash the coverslips three times with 1 mL intracellular washing buffer.
Incubate the washed samples with intracellular CuAAC solution for 45 minutes at 37°C.
Thoroughly wash the samples with 1× PBS to remove all free protein from the blocking step.
Aspirate the CuAAC solution and wash the samples three times with 1 mL intracellular washing buffer.
Incubate the washed samples with intracellular washing buffer containing 1 μg/mL streptavidin, Alexa Fluor™ 488 conjugate protected from light at 20°C.
Wash three times with 1 mL intracellular washing buffer.
Wash once with 1× PBS.
Centrifuge the plate in a plate centrifuge at 500 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by ‘flicking’ the plate.
Resuspend the cells in 150 μL PBS-BSA.
Stain membrane sialoglycans with biotinylated MALII lectin.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL PBS-BSA containing 5 μg/mL biotinylated MALII.
Incubate the samples for 45 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by ‘flicking’.
Wash twice with 150 μL PBS-BSA by centrifugation.
Label alkyne-tagged surface sialoglycans by click chemistry.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 100 μL extracellular CuAAC solution.
Incubate for 20 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by flicking.
Wash three times with 150 μL PBS-BSA buffer by centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 100 μL PBS-BSA containing 1 μg/mL streptavidin-PE conjugate.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C protected from light.
Wash the samples three times with 150 μL PBS-BSA by centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 100 μL PBS-BSA and keep at 4°C protected from light.
Immediately before measurement, resuspend the cells by pipetting or using built-in shaking options from the flow cytometer to ensure that the cells are in solution.
Acquire the samples using the CytoFlex flow cytometer plate-reader function or a flow cytometer with similar parameters.
Start with HEK293 cells growing in a 6-well plate for 3 days in the presence of 100 μM Ac5SiaNAz or equal concentrations of DMSO.
Take off the supernatant.
Collect the supernatants into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the supernatant tubes at 300 × g for 5 min to remove cells.
Transfer the supernatant into clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Gently wash adherent cells twice with 1 mL 1× PBS (RT).
Aspirate the supernatant after washing.
Add 400 μL ice-cold cell lysis buffer per well.
Detach the cells by repeated vigorous pipetting or scraping.
Check that all cells are detached using a light microscope at 4× or 10× magnification.
Hold the plate at a 45° angle and transfer samples into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Incubate the samples on ice for 1 h, vortexing for 10 s after 30 min.
Vortex the sample tubes thoroughly.
Centrifuge in a microcentrifuge at high speed (>10,000 × g) for at least 10 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant containing soluble sialoglycoproteins to clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Determine the protein concentration in cell lysates using a BCA Protein Assay Kit following manufacturer's instructions.
Load 30–50 μg of cell lysate per sample on a protein gel and run the gel for 30 min at 60 V to run samples out the slots and 60 min at 130 V in SD-PAGE running buffer to separate proteins by size.
Transfer proteins onto a nitrocellulose membrane for at least 60 min at 275 mA/100 V using ice cold 1× transfer buffer.
Stain the nitrocellulose membrane with Ponceau S solution to detect blotted lysates and confirm equal loading of protein (optional).
Rinse the blot in dH2O once after staining.
Submerge the blot in Ponceau S solution in a fume hood for at least 5 min at 20°C gently shaking (30–50 rpm).
Remove Ponceau S solution from the blot and rinse with dH2O until background appears clear.
Acquire an image of the membrane after rinsing.
Place the membrane into a clean incubation tray with the protein side facing upwards.
Add 30 ml of membrane blocking buffer to the tray containing the membrane.
Incubate shaking for 1 h at 20°C or >4 h at 4°C.
Discard the blocking buffer and wash the membrane three times for 5 min with 30 mL 1× PBS shaking at 20°C.
Wash the membrane once with 30 mL demi water shaking at 20°C.
Incubate the membrane in 30 mL membrane CuAAC solution for 45 min at 37°C shaking.
Discard the click reaction buffer and wash the membrane four times for 5 min with 20 mL PBS-BSA shaking at room temperature.
Transfer the membrane into a 50 mL tube.
Add 4 mL PBS-BSA containing 1 μg/mL Streptavidin, Alexa Fluor™ 647 conjugate to the tube.
Incubate on a tube roller for 1 h at 20°C or >4 h at 4°C protected from light.
Wash the membrane four times for 5 min with 20 mL PBS-T shaking at 20°C.
Image the membrane with a fluorescent membrane imaging system.
Culture Jurkat cells for 72 hours with 100 μM Ac5SiaNPoc or DMSO control.
Distribute the cells into a 96-well V-bottom plate at a density of 0.1–0.2 × 10^6 cells/well.
Centrifuge the plate for 3 minutes at 500 × g and 4°C, then discard the supernatant by flicking the plate.
Wash the cells twice with 150 μL of 1× PBS by centrifugation and discarding the supernatant by flicking.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL of on-cell Siglec ligand synthesis buffer and incubate for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Centrifuge the plate again for 3 minutes at 500 × g and 4°C, then discard the supernatant by flicking the plate.
Wash the cells twice with 1× PBS-BSA by centrifugation and discarding the supernatant by flicking.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL of Siglec-3 staining buffer and incubate for 1 hour at 4°C, protected from light.
Centrifuge the plate once more for 3 minutes at 500 × g and 4°C, then discard the supernatant by flicking the plate.
Wash the cells twice with 150 μL of PBS-BSA by centrifugation and discarding the supernatant by flicking.
Resuspend the cell pellets in 100 μL of PBS-BSA and pipette up and down to create a single-cell suspension.
Mix other probes or dyes with cells for staining, ensuring they do not interfere with Siglec binding and are compatible with the selected fluorophores.
Resuspend cells by pipetting immediately before and during measurement to ensure cells remain in solution.
Acquire samples using the CytoFlex flow cytometer plate-reader function or a similar flow cytometer.
Use strain-promoted azide-alkyne cycloaddition (SPAAC) as an alternative for bioorthogonal chemistry, which is spontaneous and copper-free.
Conjugate azides and alkynes in cells using copper-catalyzed click chemistry to form triazole for high-affinity Siglec-3 binding.
